bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-cfc999ac-20261115"
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 60
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
row="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT state||'|'||COALESCE(message_id::text,'0')||'|'||message_thread_id::text FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' AND chat_id=-1003770334893 LIMIT 1" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 61
case "$row" in
 verified\|*) code=1;;
 published\|*) code=2;;
 publishing\|*) code=3;;
 needs_reconcile\|*) code=4;;
 *) code=5;;
esac
if [ "$row" != "" ]; then code=$((code+10)); fi
case "$row" in *\|0\|*) ;; *) code=$((code+20));; esac
echo GAY_POSTING_PANEL_STATUS_CLASSIFIED
exit $((100+code))
